title: Pure tensor transport of the unit-defined first-factor external section map
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ and $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ schemes [def-pc-scheme], and $F,G$ module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Put $P=X\times_kY$, $p=\mathrm{pr}_1$, $q=\mathrm{pr}_2$, and $H=p^*F\otimes q^*G$. For an open $V$ of $X$, let $u_V:F(V)\otimes_k\Gamma(Y,G)\to H(p^{-1}V)$ send $s\otimes t$ to the tensor of the $p$-pullback unit applied to $s$ and the restriction to $p^{-1}V$ of the $q$-pullback unit applied to $t$ at $Y$. With the scalar actions and canonical external tensor map [def-sc-scalar-global-sections-comparison], there are $k$-linear isomorphisms $e_S:F(V)\otimes_k\Gamma(Y,G)\cong\Gamma(V,F|_V)\otimes_k\Gamma(Y,G)$ and $e_T:H(p^{-1}V)\cong\Gamma(V\times_kY,p_V^*(F|_V)\otimes q_V^*G)$ such that for every $s,t$, $e_T(u_V(s\otimes t))$ equals the canonical external tensor map on $V\times_kY$ evaluated at $e_S(s\otimes t)$. No cover, quasi-coherence, compactness or nonemptiness assumption is imposed.

proof.text: Use the first-factor open base-change lemma to obtain the scalar restriction isomorphism eF, the two coefficient isomorphisms eM,eN and their formulas on the two factor units. The base-change morphism is an open immersion and its image is the inverse image of V under p.

Apply the general scalar-linear open tensor-section transport lemma to p*F and q*G, using eM and eN. Tensor eF with identity on Gamma(Y,G) to obtain eS. The target isomorphism is eT from the general lemma. Expand externalSectionsUnitAppLeft on a pure tensor, apply the general tensor-section formula, and then the two factor-unit formulas. The result is exactly externalGlobalSectionsTensor evaluated on eS of that pure tensor.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_externalSectionsUnitOpenTransportLeft
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules) (V : X.Opens) :
    ∃ eS : scalarObj f F (op V) ⊗ scalarObj g G (op ⊤) ≅
        ModuleCat.of k (scalarObj (V.ι ≫ f) (F.restrict V.ι) (op ⊤) ⊗[k]
          scalarObj g G (op ⊤)),
    ∃ eT : scalarObj (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) (externalCupCoefficients f g F G)
        (op (pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ V)) ≅
        scalarObj (pullback.fst (V.ι ≫ f) g ≫ (V.ι ≫ f))
          (externalCupCoefficients (V.ι ≫ f) g (F.restrict V.ι) G) (op ⊤),
      ∀ (s : scalarObj f F (op V)) (t : scalarObj g G (op ⊤)),
        eT.hom (externalSectionsUnitAppLeft f g F G V (s ⊗ₜ[k] t)) =
          externalGlobalSectionsTensor (V.ι ≫ f) g (F.restrict V.ι) G
            (eS.hom (s ⊗ₜ[k] t))
